entities.name: Query protein 107 aa
observations: Sequence length is 107 aa; estimated molecular mass is 11.78 kDa and theoretical pI is 4.56.
Sequence has a strongly acidic predicted net charge at pH 7 and no apparent signal peptide or transmembrane segment from the available analysis.
Pfam Ppnp domain PF06865.18 spans residues 14-105 with i-Evalue 1.2e-31.
Best reviewed homologs are pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases with 46.7-51.5% identity, 94.4-98.1% coverage, and E-values around 1e-30.
Function is therefore most likely broad-spectrum nucleoside phosphorolysis, but exact substrate range remains homology-based rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: Q46XL0
observations: Reviewed Cupriavidus pinatubonensis pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase.
Catalyzes reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to free bases and D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Annotated EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2; cytosolic GO annotation GO:0005829.

entities.name: Ppnp domain PF06865
observations: Pfam domain detected in the query from residues 14-105 with i-Evalue 1.2e-31.
The domain assignment supports membership in the pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase family.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: Representative reaction: purine D-ribonucleoside + phosphate reversibly yields the free purine base + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Rhea mappings include RHEA:19805 and substrate-specific examples for adenosine, guanosine, cytidine, and inosine.
